reviews.name: James Kent
reviews.text: I’ve been using this company for my AC maintenance and I can’t recommend them highly enough. From the first visit, it was clear I was dealing with someone genuinely honest — no upselling, no inventing problems that don’t exist, just …

reviews.name: K Mills
reviews.text: Awesome company, awesome service. I was having issues with my dryer and knew it was airflow but the vents were not reachable by me. They kept me informed, showed up and did a great job. They educated me on what was going on and fixed it! Reasonable prices and I will use them going forward for all my HVAC needs.

reviews.name: Laura Carrillo
reviews.text: As we searched, we ended finding out that AMW Cooling and Heating, LLC was rated #2 on the top 10 list per CHAT GPT based on ratings. At this point we were without AC for a day already and just went out on a limb. Fortunately for us, we …

reviews.name: Kimberly Greenup
reviews.text: Josh was amazing! I had an emergency with my A/C and he came right out. He was extremely professional and knowledgeable. I highly recommend AMW Cooling and Heating! I will definitely be signing up for the maintenance program. Love that this is a Veteran owned company. Thank you Josh!!

reviews.name: Don Tollefson
reviews.text: Josh at AMW Cooling & Heating is prompt, personal and professional. He has handled our HVAC needs extremely well. We are exceptionally pleased and heartily recommend his service.
